method_summary: Audio features for 6 of 35 catalog tracks were fetched 2026-09-16 from ReccoBeats API v1 (https://api.reccobeats.com/v1), a free third-party music database with Spotify-like audio features, used as the documented fallback after Spotify deprecated its own /v1/audio-features endpoint (Nov 2024). Verified two-step flow, firsthand: GET /v1/track?ids=<Spotify IDs> resolves Spotify IDs to ReccoBeats UUIDs (path-param /v1/track/:id does NOT accept Spotify IDs directly), then GET /v1/audio-features?ids=<UUIDs> returns the 12 Spotify-shaped fields (acousticness, danceability, energy, instrumentalness, key, liveness, loudness, mode, speechiness, tempo, valence). All 6 returned values passed range sanity checks (tempo 0-250 BPM, key 0-11, mode 0/1, others 0-1, loudness -60..2 dB) and the resolved track title/artist matched the catalog. No API key; requests sequential with 1.5s sleeps, no rate-limit (429) hit.
honest_limits: 6 of 35 tracks carry audio features, every number traced to a live ReccoBeats API response fetched 2026-09-16. ReccoBeats is an independent third-party: its values come from its own analysis/crawl, NOT from Spotify's deprecated audio-features endpoint, and may differ from the numbers Spotify's models once produced. 21 of the 27 Spotify-ID-resolved tracks (including Diabolique, Shaka Zulu, Doves & Diamonds, Full Moon, Everything Greezy, and Pix) are simply absent from ReccoBeats' database — single and batch lookups return an empty match, not an error — so their features are null rather than estimated. The 8 tracks without verified Spotify IDs (all 7 King Akeem singles plus 183 Wildboi 'Stunt') were left untouched and never guessed. Coverage grows only when tracks enter ReccoBeats' database; re-run the lookup before assuming more.
